newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India follows locals lower, market wary.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India follows locals lower, market wary.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts (GDRs) followed the local market lower after profit-taking in London late on Wednesday turned into a 2.72 percent fall on the local market.
"The GDR market had looked ready to turn yesterday after ending slightly lower. Today after the locals went down, London was also marked lower," said a trader.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed down 1.30 points, or 2.00 percent, at 63.85 points, with the premium over the local market at 11.69 percent compared with yesterday's 10.85 percent.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index lost 90.92 points to 3,250.94.
"It is difficult to see where this market is going to establish a trading range. One thing is certain is that it is not going to be the higher end of a 3,300-3,500 point range," said the trader.
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended down 1.06 points, or 1.48 percent, at 70.66, a premium of 30.17 percent over the local market, compared with yesterday's 30.58 percent.
The Korea Composite Index fell 7.54 points to provisionally close at 804.44.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index ended up 0.95 points, 1.08 percent, at 88.62, a premium of 2.79 percent after 2.68 percent yesterday.
The Taiwan Weighted Index rose 21.85 points or 0.34 percent to 6,458.91. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
